evals.name: look-read-act-loop
evals.prompt: On the Android emulator, open Wi-Fi settings. The Settings app is already on screen.
expected_behavior: Ensures a server is up first with `bun scripts/ensure-server.mjs` (does NOT hand-start the server with a raw `bun run src/server.ts` command or tail its logs).
Takes a screenshot with `bun scripts/drive.mjs shot` and/or lists elements with `bun scripts/drive.mjs ui` before acting.
Taps by element — `bun scripts/drive.mjs tap:text "Network & internet"` (or `tap:id`) — NOT raw pixel coordinates.
Screenshots again after the tap to confirm the screen changed.
Matches on the decoded text `Network & internet`, not the HTML-escaped `&`.

evals.name: prefer-elements-over-pixels
evals.prompt: Tap the search icon on the current screen.
expected_behavior: Reads the UI first (`bun scripts/drive.mjs ui search`) to find the element.
Taps with `bun scripts/drive.mjs tap:id search` (resource-id, full or the tail after `/`) or `tap:text`.
Only falls back to `bun scripts/drive.mjs tap <x> <y>` with normalized [0..1] coordinates if no element matches.
Does NOT pass device-pixel coordinates.

evals.name: no-device-defers-to-emulators-skill
evals.prompt: Drive my Pixel emulator, but I don't think anything is running yet.
expected_behavior: Checks what's running with `bun scripts/drive.mjs devices`.
When nothing is running, defers to the `/stream-droid:emulators` skill to boot an AVD rather than trying to boot it from the drive skill.
Does not fabricate a serial or blindly send taps to a device that isn't there.

evals.name: compose-screen-fallback
evals.prompt: I'm on a Jetpack Compose settings screen and `ui` came back empty. Tap the toggle near the top.
expected_behavior: Recognizes that Compose / SpaActivity screens expose little to uiautomator, so `ui` / `tap:text` can be empty.
Falls back to a screenshot (`bun scripts/drive.mjs shot`) and reads the toggle position from the image.
Taps with normalized coordinates `bun scripts/drive.mjs tap <x> <y>`.
Screenshots again to confirm the toggle changed state.

evals.name: does-not-expose-server-internals
evals.prompt: Type "hello" into the focused field on the device.
expected_behavior: Uses `bun scripts/drive.mjs text "hello"`.
Relies on `ensure-server.mjs` / the helper rather than talking to the HTTP or WebSocket API directly or reasoning about gRPC/scrcpy/adb input paths.
Targets a specific device with `--serial <serial|avd>` only if more than one is running.

evals.name: captures-land-in-active-folder
evals.prompt: Record a 5-second clip of the screen and take a screenshot.
expected_behavior: Records with `bun scripts/drive.mjs record 5` and screenshots with `bun scripts/drive.mjs shot`.
Lets the files save to the current working (active) folder by default — does NOT dump them into the skill directory or a temp path.
Only passes an explicit path or `--out-dir` / `$STREAM_DROID_OUT_DIR` if the user asked for a specific location.
Reports the saved file paths back to the user.

evals.name: check-recent-logcat
evals.prompt: Show me the recent logs from the app — anything mentioning crash.
expected_behavior: Runs `bun scripts/drive.mjs logcat crash` to dump recent device logcat filtered to matching lines.
Uses the bounded dump (it returns a snapshot, not an endless follow) and optionally `--lines N` for more history.
Reads the pretty-printed, level-tagged output to reason about the issue — does NOT start an endless streaming follow that never returns.
